[{"id": 1, "source": "develop/go/activities/timeouts.mdx", "headings": "Activity Heartbeats {/* #activity-heartbeats */}", "chunk_id": "087cce8646bb168bbbae5a9bce3b75d4004d75e6013a4c8de3669533e0258009", "text": "

output.answer: In Go you record a heartbeat with the RecordActivityHeartbeat (RecordHeartbeat) API, and in Python you use the heartbeat() API.
